impact: Positioning is defensive into Nvidia's print, so a solid guide could spark a sharp short-covering bounce in MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS, while a miss risks extending the AI drawdown.
summary: US stocks lost ground Tuesday ahead of Nvidia's results after the close (due around 4:20 p.m. ET), with Yahoo Finance reporting losses picking up through the session after Monday's 1.9% S&P 500 drop. 24/7 Wall St. said the Nasdaq 100 is headed for its worst November since 2008, and Nvidia is down about 26% from its peak going into the report. Intraday figures varied widely across sources.
title: Stocks lose ground before Nvidia; Nasdaq 100 on track for worst November since 2008
